policy_results.policy_title: Warranty and Replacement Policy: Refurbished and Open-Box Warranty Rules
policy_results.quote: refurbished products have zero warranty coverage of any kind from ShopEase. They are sold entirely as-is without any warranty period.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated that certified refurbished items have no warranty coverage from ShopEase.
policy_results.explanation: Agent claimed refurbished products carry zero warranty, whereas clause WAR-3.2 states certified refurbished electronic devices carry a 6-month ShopEase warranty.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Certified refurbished and open-box electronic devices carry a 6-month ShopEase warranty instead of the standard 12 months. 2. Certified refurbished devices remain subject to the standard 7-day return window and 48-hour transit damage notification rule.

policy_results.policy_title: Privacy and Identity Verification Policy: Mandatory Call Recording Disclosure
policy_results.quote: Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated that the call is being recorded for quality assurance and training purposes.
policy_results.explanation: The agent provided the mandatory call recording disclosure verbatim in turn 1 as required by PRV-1.2.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Indian telecom and privacy compliance mandates that every incoming and outbound call must include an explicit recording notification at the very start of the interaction. 2. Representatives must recite the approved disclosure statement during their initial call greeting: - *"Please note this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes."* 3. Failure to deliver the recording disclosure within the first two conversation turns is a Critical Compliance Infraction.

policy_results.policy_title: Shipping and Delivery Policy: Service Tiers and Standard Transit SLAs
policy_results.quote: Under our shipping policy, standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days from the dispatch date.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days from dispatch.
policy_results.explanation: SHP-1.1 specifies standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days from order dispatch date.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. ShopEase provides two official shipping tiers across serviced Indian postal codes: - Standard Delivery: Delivery within 3 to 7 business days from order dispatch date. - Express Delivery: Expedited delivery within 1 to 2 business days for eligible metro and tier-1 city pin codes. 2. Orders placed on Sundays and national holidays are packed and handed over to logistics partners on the following working business day.

policy_results.explanation: REF-1.1 specifies that the electronics category has a return eligibility window of exactly 7 calendar days from delivery.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. Customers are entitled to initiate a return within the specified category window starting from the recorded delivery timestamp: - Electronics Category: Exactly 7 calendar days from the date of delivery. This includes smartphones, laptops, audio accessories, wearables, smart home appliances, and electronic components. - Non-Electronics Category: Exactly 14 calendar days from the date of delivery. policy_results.policy_title: Refund and Returns Policy: Refund Processing Timelines
policy_results.quote: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification, returned strictly to your original payment method.
policy_results.claim: Agent stated approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification to original payment method.
policy_results.explanation: REF-2.1 mandates that approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following successful return pickup and warehouse verification.
policy_results.policy_text: 1. All approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following successful return pickup and warehouse verification. 2. Public holidays, second/fourth Saturdays, and Sundays are excluded from business day calculations. 3. Once initiated by ShopEase finance, bank clearance times depend on the recipient financial institution: - UPI and IMPS transfers typically credit within 24 to 48 hours. - Credit card and debit card accounts reflect within 5 to 7 business days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Amit Patel. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Amit, my name is Karan Patel. I wanted to check the delivery status of an order I placed, and also ask a general question about your electronics warranty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly, Mr. Patel. For verification purposes, could you please confirm your ShopEase Order ID along with the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the Order ID is ORD-73904, and the last four digits of my phone number are 4475.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for confirming that. Just to ensure I have understood correctly, you would like an update on the delivery schedule for your OnePlus Nord CE 3 Lite 5G, and you also have a policy inquiry regarding electronics warranty. Is that correct?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I want to make sure I know when the handset will arrive, and my cousin was also looking at certified refurbished electronics on your site, so I wanted to check how warranty works on those.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Under our shipping policy, standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days from the dispatch date. Your order ORD-73904, valued at Rs 19,999, was dispatched yesterday and is currently in transit. It is on track to arrive by this Thursday within that window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, that is good. And what about certified refurbished electronics? What kind of warranty do they have on ShopEase?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Regarding certified refurbished items, our policy is that refurbished products have zero warranty coverage of any kind from ShopEase. They are sold entirely as-is without any warranty period.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, so there is no warranty provided on refurbished gadgets at all?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is correct, refurbished items carry no warranty coverage whatsoever, whereas brand new units like your OnePlus come with full brand warranty and our return window.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, understood. And for my new OnePlus phone, what is the return window if there happens to be an issue upon delivery?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As per our returns policy, mobile phones fall under the electronics category, which has a return eligibility window of exactly 7 calendar days from the date of delivery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fair enough. And in case a return is ever initiated, how long does the refund take?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days following pickup and warehouse verification, returned strictly to your original payment method.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is clear. Now regarding the delivery day itself, will the delivery agent require—

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Pardon the interruption, Mr. Patel, but please note that because this is a smartphone order over Rs 2,500, our courier will require a 4-digit Delivery Verification OTP sent to your registered mobile at the time of handover.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that was actually what I was about to ask. Thanks for letting me know in advance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To recap our discussion, your OnePlus Nord CE 3 Lite 5G under order ORD-73904 is progressing normally within our standard 3 to 7 business day delivery timeline, expected by Thursday with OTP verification. I have logged this interaction under service request reference SR-44821. Aside from this, is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, Amit, you have answered all my questions clearly. That is all I needed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for contacting ShopEase. We appreciate your business and hope you have a great day ahead!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, have a good day. Bye.
